// diagnostic E0165

Jet.CompoundAssignNotPlace

Compound assignment needs a mutable place.

What

Compound assignment needs a mutable place.

Why

Updates are allowed only on a mutable name or an `&` parameter; a computed value has no place to update.

Fix

Bind the value with `:=`, then write `name {op} value`

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.CompoundAssignNotPlace: Tests/UI/compound_non_place_target.stderr.

Error: Jet.CompoundAssignNotPlace: Compound assignment needs a mutable place.

    |
  3 |     make() += 1
    |     ^^^^
 Why: Updates are allowed only on a mutable name or an `&` parameter; a computed value has no place to update.
 Fix: Bind the value with `:=`, then write `name += value`
